vo.en: I’m about to control your brain.

visual.description: A glowing blue neural network with fast-moving electrical pulses shooting through digital fiber optics.

vo.en: Look at the number 2,400. Keep it in your head. Now, how much does this luxury watch cost?

visual.description: A macro close-up of a rotating luxury watch face with intricate gold gears and sweeping hands.

vo.en: Comment your guess now. If you guessed high, you’re trapped. This watch is actually under two hundred dollars.

visual.description: Slow-motion shot of a man's hands fanning out a stack of hundred-dollar bills.

vo.en: But here’s the creepy part: your brain uses that first number as a magnet for every decision.

visual.description: A powerful horseshoe magnet pulling a pile of iron nails towards it in a sharp, sudden motion.

vo.en: Marketing pros show a two-thousand-dollar tag first so that one hundred looks like a total steal.

visual.description: A close-up of a hand flipping over a red price tag in a high-end retail store.

vo.en: Subscribe for tomorrow's mind hack—and comment WORKED if I got you. You’re being manipulated by how...

visual.description: Close-up of a thumb tapping a smartphone screen to click a notification bell icon.
